repair: Explicit lifecycle model: named states + legal transitions; atomic claiming separating permission-to-act from recovery leases; no automatic requeue on ordinary failure
control_type: explicit state model + atomic claim + no-requeue policy
recurrence_classification: later-hardening (stale-owner sweep exposed 'slow is not dead' -> progress evidence added; NOT a recurrence of the original class)
evidence_provenance: book 5.2 'implicit lifecycle became explicit behavioral model'; JobStateMachine in web/pipeline.py; lint-no-failure-requeue.py
notes: The dominant early production failure. Recovery became a decision over explicit state+evidence.

evidence_provenance: book 5.2 'a cross-service assumption became a typed client'; shared/service_client.py ServiceClient (BinaryIO); web/ipc sole-seam lint

triggering_incident: By ~300k lines, MVP-fast regions lacked coherent abstractions; 'use typed Python' was satisfied stringly-typed (the type 'string' for everything)

recurrence_classification: no-observed-recurrence (the rule + migration removed the ceiling; not a mechanical control)
evidence_provenance: book 5.2 'a recurring architectural ceiling became a decision rule'; serverless migration; k8s-poll-architecture-retirement-260722
notes: A lesson held in someone's head remains expensive to reuse — encoding it in the system made it capital.

triggering_incident: Merge automation stalled when two agents edited the same file; a one-flag 'take one side, drop the other' fix silently deleted landed work from main for four days (same commit heading landing repeatedly, each time smaller)
repair: The resolver was changed to reconcile the conflicting files; the destructive drop-a-side default was prohibited

evidence_provenance: book 5.2 'an unmade decision became a decision made once'; merge_train resolver
notes: Do not leave consequential semantics unresolved where an autonomous actor must act.

triggering_incident: Two near-simultaneous false-greens: a lint gate hit a stray error, caught it in a catch-all returning success (a run of commits landed unlinted); a chain of pin tests passed because a botched merge landed them onto a tree missing the field they checked
repair: Regenerate evidence at the admission boundary: required tests + lints re-run against the actual candidate tree; gate failures made fail-loud (no catch-all success); counts re-derived rather than accepted from the task report
recurrence_classification: attempted-recurrence-caught (merge-train re-runs the full gate on the candidate tree; fail-loud replaces swallow)
evidence_provenance: book 5.2 'Done became a claim requiring independent evidence'; rule #8 never-silent-catch; merge_train CI gate
notes: A report of 'done' describes the producer's claim, not the repository state.

triggering_incident: A content-free image detector (skip vision if pixels barely vary) would mark a Rothko / Malevich black square decorative; its own comment promised a false positive was 'not possible'
repair: Ambiguous cases route to a richer semantic (VLM) judgment; regression evidence covers the failure CLASS (low-variance images that carry content), not just the first example

evidence_provenance: book 5.2 'an inadequate input representation became a routed judgment'; a11y semantic post-filter (classify-first §13)
notes: 'Content-free' is a judgment about an image in context, not a fact about pixels.

triggering_incident: A corrupted document took four cross-file hops to trace; verification found ELEVEN production sites writing through a low-level path that skipped the provenance stamp, shipping empty changelog rows for a class of jobs
repair: The provenance join: every mutation stamps verb+pass+visibility; the customer changelog is derived from stamps; a wiring validator identifies mutating paths that fail to stamp — landed report-first, then a fix wave drained, then enforced
recurrence_classification: attempted-recurrence-caught (F10 wiring lint now blocks unstamped mutators). Landing discipline: AUDIT-ONLY-first then BLOCKING (rule #55)
evidence_provenance: book 5.2 'forensic reconstruction became derived provenance'; lint-mutator-stamp-wiring.py; MutatorStampHelper
notes: Representation made the obligation observable; migration made it feasible; gating enforced it.

triggering_incident: A document's repair stalled silently; the subprocess was killed by the job timeout after ~8 minutes, the customer's progress bar frozen at 38%, the budget already spent

recurrence_classification: no-observed-recurrence-and-deliberately-not-enforced (no production gate rejects on this model; bound not calibrated strongly enough to justify blocking)
